note: Build shelf: buildings, props and authored trees name world-catalog assets; procedural trees carry a size. Doodads are loose props with no door: a prop whose asset has a catalog footprint blocks movement, one without does not. Studio-only scenery candidates can be placed without changing the shipped area. Policies control catalog access and object allowances; appearance paint is unlimited.
